query_details.original_query: Compare every county in the US
query_details.description: Requesting comparison of all 3,222 US counties simultaneously - an unreasonably broad query designed to test system limits

system_behavior.description: System recognized the overly broad request and responded with helpful guidance instead of attempting to process all 3,222 counties

system_response.full_text: That's a bit too broad. Comparing all 3,222 US counties at once would be overwhelming. To give you a meaningful analysis, could you please narrow your request? For example, we could start by: Ranking the top 10 most at-risk counties nationwide. Focusing on a specific state. Analyzing a particular type of risk, like health disparities or infrastructure gaps.
system_response.key_message: Request too broad - suggests narrowing scope
suggested_alternatives: Rank top 10 most at-risk counties nationwide
Analyze a particular type of risk (health disparities, infrastructure gaps)

findings: System did NOT attempt to process all 3,222 counties (would cause timeout/crash)
System responded in reasonable time (11.5 seconds)
System provided clear explanation of why request was too broad
System offered 3 concrete alternatives for user to consider
No error messages, stack traces, or system failures occurred
Response was conversational and helpful rather than technical/rejecting
recommendations: Current implementation is ROBUST - no changes needed for scope overload handling
Consider adding explicit 'max counties per query' parameter in documentation
Optional: Provide UI hint about reasonable query scope limits
test_conclusion: PASS - System demonstrates excellent graceful degradation under scope overload conditions
